{{Top|leg}}
'''Future of [[Honoghr/Legends|Honoghr]]''' was the term used by the [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]] to describe the hidden canyon in which they began growing all manner of [[Plant/Legends|plants]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. After decades of living with the [[Mutant|mutated]] [[kholm-grass]] created by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] proved to the Noghri that the Empire's grasp on them was only through fear. Until the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]], however, the Noghri were forced to hide their growing crops so as not to be massacred again.
